blocks.text: Organic nitrogen compounds zindagi aur aaj ki duniya ke liye bohat zaroori hain. Zindagi ki bunyad amino acids aur nucleotides hain, aur in se proteins bante hain jo zindagi ke sab se ahem compounds hain. Amines aur nitro compounds dye (rang banane ki) industry aur dawaiyon mein bohat ahem hain. Nylon, Kevlar aur polyurethane nitrogen wale polymers hain jo har ghar aur daftar mein milte hain. Is ke ilawa nitrogen compounds hamari khurak, fertilisers (khaad) aur explosives (dhamaka khez maadde) ka bhi hissa hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Coffee ka caffeine aur chocolate ka theobromine dono organic nitrogen compounds hain. Yeh active compounds hain jo hamara mood khush karte hain. Dono mein farq kya hai? Jawab: in ki banawat mein sirf aik methyl group ka farq hai; caffeine mein ring ke aik nitrogen par CH₃ hai jahan theobromine mein H hai.

blocks.alt: Do khuli banawatein saath saath, har aik mein chhe-kona ring paanch-kona ring se juri, C aur N atoms ke labels, do C=O groups aur N-CH3 groups. Caffeine mein teen ring nitrogens par CH3 hai; theobromine mein baen wale nitrogen par CH3 ki jagah H hai.
blocks.caption: Caffeine aur theobromine (kitab ke PDF safha 119 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono molecules ka dhaancha (skeleton) aik jaisa hai: chhe-kona aur paanch-kona ring aapas mein juri hui. Farq sirf baen taraf wale nitrogen par hai: caffeine mein wahan CH₃ hai aur theobromine mein H. Kitab ne paanch-kona ring ke neeche wale carbon par H nahi dikhaya; carbon ke chaar bond poore karne ke liye drawing mein wahan C–H bana diya gaya hai.

Amines ko ammonia ke organic derivatives samjha jata hai: ammonia (NH₃) ke aik, do ya teen hydrogen atoms ki jagah alkyl ya aryl groups aa jate hain. Kitne hydrogen atoms badle gaye, isi se amines ki teen qismein banti hain: primary, secondary aur tertiary. Primary amine mein -NH₂ group ke saath aik alkyl ya aryl group jura hota hai. IUPAC naamon mein amines ko alkanamines kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Primary amines: CH3-NH2 (methanamine), CH3-CH2-NH2 (ethanamine), CH3-CH2-CH2-NH2 (propan-1-amine), aur NH2 wali benzene ring (phenyl amine, aniline).
blocks.caption: Primary amines: methanamine, ethanamine, propan-1-amine aur phenyl amine (aniline) (kitab ke PDF safha 119 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Secondary amines mein NH group ke saath do alkyl ya aryl groups jure hote hain, maslan:

blocks.alt: Secondary amines: CH3-NH-CH3 (N-methylmethanamine), CH3-NH-CH2-CH3 (N-methylethanamine), aur NH se juri do benzene rings (diphenyl amine).
blocks.caption: Secondary amines: N-methylmethanamine, N-methylethanamine aur diphenyl amine (kitab ke PDF safha 119 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ne N-methylmethanamine ko CH₃–NH₂–CH₃ aur N-methylethanamine ko CH₃–NH₂–CH₂–CH₃ chhapa hai. Yeh ghalat hai: do groups se jure nitrogen par sirf aik H hota hai (–NH–), warna nitrogen ke chaar bond ho jate aur woh neutral na rehta. Is liye drawing mein CH₃–NH–CH₃ aur CH₃–NH–CH₂–CH₃ likha hai.
Tertiary amines mein aik hi nitrogen atom ke saath teen alkyl ya aryl groups jure hote hain, maslan:

blocks.alt: Tertiary amines: N,N-dimethylmethanamine jis ke N par teen CH3 groups hain (aik oopar, do dono taraf), aur triphenylamine, jis ka N teen benzene rings se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Tertiary amines: N,N-dimethylmethanamine aur triphenylamine (kitab ke PDF safha 119 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne label ‘N-N-dimethylmethanamine’ chhapa hai; sahi naam N,N-dimethylmethanamine hai (dono N ke darmiyan comma).
Aise nitrogen derivatives bhi hote hain jin mein nitrogen par chaar groups hon; inhein quaternary ammonium salts kehte hain, maslan:

blocks.alt: Tetramethylammonium chloride: chaar CH3 groups wala nitrogen atom (oopar, neeche, baen, daen) square brackets mein, bracket ke bahar + charge, aur saath Cl-.
blocks.caption: Tetramethylammonium chloride, aik quaternary ammonium namak (kitab ke PDF safha 120 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Amine primary hai, secondary ya tertiary, yeh nitrogen atom par branching (shaakhon) se tay hota hai, nitrogen se jure carbon atom se nahi. Alcohols aur monohaloalkanes (alkyl halides) mein aisa nahi hota; wahan qism carbon atom se tay hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: a) In compounds ke IUPAC naam batayein: (i) CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₂–CH₂–NH₂, (ii) CH₃–CH₂–CH(NH₂)–CH₃, (iii) CH₃–CH₂–CH(CH₂CH₃)–CH(CH₂CH₃)–NH–CH₂–CH₃.
blocks.explanation: (i) 4-methylpentan-1-amine; (ii) butan-2-amine (kitab khud likhti hai ke yahan NH₂ muraad tha); (iii) N,4-diethylhexan-3-amine (N wale carbon se guzarti sab se lambi chain chhe carbon ki hai).

blocks.prompt: b) In amines ke structures banayein: 2,4-dimethylhexan-3-amine, N-methylpentan-1-amine, 2-methylcyclohexan-1-amine, N,N-dimethylethanamine.
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH(CH₃)CH(NH₂)CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃; CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₂NHCH₃; cyclohexane ring jis ke C1 par NH₂ aur agle carbon (C2) par CH₃ ho; CH₃CH₂N(CH₃)₂.

answer_figure.alt: Chaar amines ke structural formulas: (i) 2,4-dimethylhexan-3-amine CH3-CH(CH3)-CH(NH2)-CH(CH3)-CH2-CH3; (ii) N-methylpentan-1-amine CH3-(CH2)4-NH-CH3; (iii) 2-methylcyclohexan-1-amine, chhe konon wala ring, kona 1 par NH2 aur kona 2 par CH3; (iv) N,N-dimethylethanamine CH3-CH2-N(CH3)-CH3.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: 2,4-dimethylhexan-3-amine, N-methylpentan-1-amine, 2-methylcyclohexan-1-amine aur N,N-dimethylethanamine ke structural formulas.
answer_figure.long_description: Pehle structure mein chhe carbon ki chain hai: carbon 3 par NH₂ (oopar) aur carbon 2 aur 4 par CH₃ branches (neeche). Doosre mein paanch carbon ki chain ke aakhri carbon se NH jura hai aur NH par aik CH₃ hai (N-methyl). Teesre mein chhe carbon ka ring hai: kona 1 par NH₂ aur us ke saath wale kone 2 par CH₃. Chauthe mein ethyl group (CH₃–CH₂–) nitrogen se jura hai aur nitrogen par do CH₃ groups hain (N,N-dimethyl).

items: Amines: ammonia jis ke H atoms alkyl ya aryl groups se badle gaye hon.
Primary RNH₂, secondary R₂NH, tertiary R₃N, quaternary ammonium salt R₄N⁺X⁻.
Qism nitrogen par lage groups se tay hoti hai, carbon se nahi.
